'''2013 Alderaan Regionals Anthony Massung LS The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Anthony Massung]] at [[2013 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One|Cor-L-thehyperdrivegeneratorsgone.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
